description: This Java source file defines a JAX-RS exception mapper class that maps AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException exceptions to HTTP responses with a JSON error payload, specifically for domain rule violations within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: PlatformDomainRuleExceptionMapper
classes.description: A Jersey ExceptionMapper to convert domain rule violation exceptions into HTTP 403 Forbidden responses with a JSON error payload.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException into a JSON HTTP response with status 403, including error details for domain rule violations.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns a specific error code (9999) for this exception mapper.
